name: ITPR exhaustive hunt (everything)
description: The all-in-one default: harvest every ITPR-like sequence (Compara paralog mine across the vertebrate panel, all-vertebrate ortholog expansion of every unnamed/novel gene found, InterPro Pfam enumeration minus known names), merge and dedupe, save the census (FASTA + CSV), then run every analysis — MSA, identity matrix, NJ tree with novel candidates highlighted, discovery scoring with MSA-signature fallback, presence/absence retention matrix — and write the full bundle + report. Takes 5-15 min against live APIs. This is the app-level hunt; the publication-grade census is the roadmap's S2-S5.
